title: X-Rays Explained: Science & Safety
description:
Discovered by Wilhelm Conrad Roentgen in 1895, X-rays transformed medicine forever by allowing doctors to see inside the human body without surgery. From the first photograph of his wife’s hand to modern-day mammography, fluoroscopy, and cancer therapy, X-rays remain one of the most powerful tools in healthcare.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we explore:

The discovery of X-rays and how they revolutionized medicine.

The physics behind cathodes, anodes, and X-ray tubes.

How X-rays create images of bones, muscles, and tissues.

The science of projectional radiography, mammography, and fluoroscopy.

Why myths about “radiation fear” spread by pseudoscience don’t hold up.

Uses beyond medicine: airport security, pipelines, welding, and aviation safety.

👉 If you’ve searched for what are X-rays, how X-rays work, discovery of X-rays, X-ray imaging explained, projectional radiography, mammography, fluoroscopy, X-rays in cancer treatment, dangers of X-rays — this video brings you the science, without the fear.
